explanation.tr:
İngilizcede iki participle vardır:
• Present participle (V-ing): etken, devam eden → a crying baby (ağlayan bebek), the man sitting there
• Past participle (V3): edilgen, tamamlanmış → a broken window (kırık pencere), a book written in 1900
• -ing / -ed sıfatlar (duygu): 
  -ing → bir şeyin nasıl OLDUĞU: The film was boring. (sıkıcıydı)
  -ed → kişinin nasıl HİSSETTİĞİ: I was bored. (sıkıldım)
  interesting/interested, exciting/excited, tiring/tired, surprising/surprised
• Participle cümlecikleri (kısaltma): Feeling tired, I went to bed. (= Because I felt tired…)
explanation.tk:
Iňlis dilinde iki participle bar:
• Present participle (V-ing): işjeň, dowam edýän → a crying baby (aglaýan çaga), the man sitting there
• Past participle (V3): edilýän, tamamlanan → a broken window (döwük penjire), a book written in 1900
• -ing / -ed sypatlar (duýgy):
  -ing → bir zadyň nähili BOLANDYGY: The film was boring. (ýakymsyzdy)
  -ed → adamyň özüni nähili DUÝANDYGY: I was bored. (içim gysdy)
  interesting/interested, exciting/excited, tiring/tired, surprising/surprised
• Participle sözlemçeleri (gysgaltma): Feeling tired, I went to bed. (= Because I felt tired…)
explanation.ru:
В английском два причастия:
• Present participle (V-ing): активное, в процессе → a crying baby (плачущий ребёнок), the man sitting there
• Past participle (V3): пассивное, завершённое → a broken window (разбитое окно), a book written in 1900
• Прилагательные на -ing / -ed (чувства):
  -ing → какой предмет: The film was boring. (скучный)
  -ed → что чувствует человек: I was bored. (мне было скучно)
  interesting/interested, exciting/excited, tiring/tired, surprising/surprised
• Причастные обороты: Feeling tired, I went to bed. (= Because I felt tired…)

explanation.tr:
Passive (edilgen), eylemi KİMİN yaptığı değil, NE YAPILDIĞI önemli olduğunda kullanılır.
• Yapı: be + V3 (be zamana göre değişir)
  Simple Present: Tea is grown in India.
  Simple Past: The bridge was built in 1990.
  Present Perfect: The car has been repaired.
  will: The results will be announced tomorrow.
  Modal: The work must be done today.
  Progressive: The room is being cleaned.
• Yapan önemliyse by ile: The book was written by Magtymguly.
• Aktiften pasife: They make cars here. → Cars are made here.
explanation.tk:
Passive (edilýän) hereketi KIMIŇ edendigi däl-de, NÄME EDILENDIGI möhüm bolanda ulanylýar.
• Gurluşy: be + V3 (be zamana görä üýtgeýär)
  Simple Present: Tea is grown in India.
  Simple Past: The bridge was built in 1990.
  Present Perfect: The car has been repaired.
  will: The results will be announced tomorrow.
  Modal: The work must be done today.
  Progressive: The room is being cleaned.
• Ýerine ýetiren möhüm bolsa by bilen: The book was written by Magtymguly.
• Işjeňden edilýäne: They make cars here. → Cars are made here.
explanation.ru:
Пассивный залог используется, когда важно не КТО сделал, а ЧТО сделано.
• Схема: be + V3 (be меняется по времени)
  Simple Present: Tea is grown in India.
  Simple Past: The bridge was built in 1990.
  Present Perfect: The car has been repaired.
  will: The results will be announced tomorrow.
  Модальные: The work must be done today.
  Progressive: The room is being cleaned.
• Если важен исполнитель — by: The book was written by Magtymguly.
• Из актива в пассив: They make cars here. → Cars are made here.

explanation.tr:
Phrasal verb = fiil + edat/zarf (up, down, on, off, out, in, back…). Anlam çoğu zaman kelimelerden tahmin edilemez.
• get up (kalkmak), wake up (uyanmak), look for (aramak), look after (bakmak), give up (vazgeçmek/bırakmak), find out (öğrenmek), turn on/off (açmak/kapatmak), put on (giymek), take off (çıkarmak; uçak kalkmak), come back (geri dönmek), go out (dışarı çıkmak), run out of (tükenmek), set up (kurmak)
• Ayrılabilenler: nesne ortada olabilir → Turn the light off. / Turn off the light. Zamirle mutlaka ortada: Turn it off. (✗ Turn off it)
• Ayrılamayanlar: look after the baby, look for my keys
explanation.tk:
Phrasal verb = işlik + sözlem/hal (up, down, on, off, out, in, back…). Manysyny köplenç sözlerden çaklap bolmaýar.
• get up (turmak), wake up (oýanmak), look for (gözlemek), look after (seretmek), give up (taşlamak), find out (bilmek), turn on/off (ýakmak/öçürmek), put on (geýmek), take off (çykarmak; uçar galmak), come back (gaýdyp gelmek), go out (daşary çykmak), run out of (gutarmak), set up (döretmek)
• Aýrylýanlar: doldurgyç ortada bolup biler → Turn the light off. / Turn off the light. Çalyşma bilen hökman ortada: Turn it off. (✗ Turn off it)
• Aýrylmaýanlar: look after the baby, look for my keys
explanation.ru:
Фразовый глагол = глагол + частица/предлог (up, down, on, off, out, in, back…). Значение часто нельзя угадать по частям.
• get up (вставать), wake up (просыпаться), look for (искать), look after (присматривать), give up (бросать/сдаваться), find out (выяснить), turn on/off (включить/выключить), put on (надеть), take off (снять; взлететь), come back (вернуться), go out (выйти, сходить куда-то), run out of (закончиться), set up (основать)
• Разделяемые: дополнение может стоять в середине → Turn the light off. / Turn off the light. С местоимением — только в середине: Turn it off. (✗ Turn off it)
• Неразделяемые: look after the baby, look for my keys
